title: Champions (D114): class fish that come up in place of a surface feature and stay on their spot until caught

chance.description: When a surface feature would appear, the chance in percent that a champion appears in its place.

max.description: The most champions on one spot at once; never two of the same class.

minBand.description: A champion is at least this size band (an id from rules/size-bands.json).

radius.description: How close to it the bobber must land, in scene pixels.

xpFactor.description: Its XP is the fish's times this.

aura.description: The aura's colour on the water (a placeholder, CR-15).

note.description: What it does, for its debuff's tooltip, where its effects don't say it.

effects.description: On every cast at its spot while it lives.

resistance.description: Added to its own roll when it's on the line.

moves.description: It moves somewhere else on the water after every cast.

spellCasts.description: How many casts each spell lasts before it casts another.

spells.description: One at a time, its effects on every cast at its spot.

weatherCasts.description: How many casts between its weathers.

weathers.description: The weathers it calls up, from any season.
